6800.title: Attachment materialization and multipart failures
6800.rootCauseOneLine: The SDK bypasses byte materialization for matching Blob inputs; empty multipart parsing escapes the upload route and returns a generic 500. The native iOS trigger remains unverified.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed, unmerged; changes match the suspected boundaries but were not run and do not prove the native WebKit repair.

6800.proposedFix: Verify byte-backed SDK normalization on a real iPhone; separately translate malformed multipart parsing into an explicit client-input response.
6800.caveats: No iOS device was available. Two clean trusted-main runs establish only the SDK branch and generic server error. No fix PR was opened.
